notes: Hostile source-only fidelity audit against Public Law 119-28 text (data/bill-text/119-HR-4.txt). All dollar figures verified verbatim; 19 foreign-aid rescissions sum to $7,903,000,001 (~$7.90B, CPB excluded). Account attributions and carve-out directions (Global Health disease protection + family-planning exclusion, ESF Jordan/Egypt/PRC, Development Assistance Feed-the-Future/PRC + food-aid, International Disaster Assistance food-aid) all correct. No material issues. Minor: "19 accounts" reads 19 numbered items over 17 distinct headings; "disease programs protected" is a loose gloss (Nutrition/Maternal-and-Child-Health included); likelihoodReason sponsor/cosponsor/simple-majority are structural metadata/procedural context absent from bill text. Two minor omissions (Europe-Eurasia $460M, USIP $15M) subsumed in the aggregate.
